Notes
 1. The dates of departure and return mentioned above must correspond with the ones stamped by the
 immigration department of Kenya and the visiting country on the passport.
 2. All claims must be submitted to the Secretary through respective Heads of Institutions at least two
 weeks before the date of departure..
 3. The claims must be accompanied by the necessary supporting documents i.e. schedule of course
 ,programmes seminars e.t.c
4. Claims should not be submitted after the teacher completes the course.
